Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, Mail Framework Mod, PPJA Collection, Artisan Valley (optional - used for Spiked Eggnog), and SpaceCore.
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 2 files included in the download:

[JA] Christmas Sweets
[MFM] Christmas Sweets

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

- Delete every existing item and machine made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods

[color=#ff7700][b]If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.[/b][/color]
